thread:
maria.g: Quick question — over on /v1/generate we've had customers send both X-API-Key: <key> and Authorization: Bearer <key2>. Which header should we prefer? I thought we canonicalize to X-API-Key for legacy, but need clarity on compatibility + rotation behavior. (cc @kevin)

kevin: We currently prefer Authorization: Bearer if present (new clients). But that's a recent change for hosted. I didn't realize some internal infra still relies on X-API-Key. We should doc this and decide a policy.

jon.s: For Dedicated/private we accept both; service resolves to the org/project from the key. Precedence: Bearer overrides — that was my PR last year.

maria.g: Concern: when a rotated key briefly coexists, clients might send old X-API-Key + new Bearer — preferring Bearer might break gradual swap flows.

lisa-pm: Product note — customers expect rotation with ~1h grace window. Prefer behavior that accepts either but emits clear warnings when there's a mismatch.

kevin: Proposal: If both present and tokens don't map to the same org/project, reject with 409 and JSON describing the mismatch. If they map to the same identity but different key ids, accept and emit an audit event + debug log. Add a deprecation header when X-API-Key is used: "X-Deprecation: x-api-key; status=deprecated" so clients get visible signal.

jon.s: Sounds reasonable. I'll add unit tests for combinations:
```http
GET /v1/generate
X-API-Key: key-old
Authorization: Bearer key-new
```
Expect: 409 when org mismatch; else 200 and an audit log entry. I'll draft the patch and tests.

maria.g: Also confirm behavior for missing scope headers: if X-Org or X-Project absent, we infer from the key. If key also missing -> 401. If key valid but project lacks access -> 403. We should be explicit in the API contract.

kevin: Current logic: valid key -> derive org/project; project-restriction -> 403. Missing/invalid auth -> 401. I'll add comments and an API doc snippet.

deploy-bot: deploy api-gateway v2.1 to staging — commit 9b2f4de

jon.s: Ping @kevin @maria.g — PR up: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/412 — small change in auth resolution + tests.

kevin: Reviewing now. Quick asks: include migration note in CHANGELOG, add `X-Unit-Test` header gating for some integration tests, and ensure metrics (auth_mismatch_count) increments on 409. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Thanks — I'm updating the compatibility doc and will link the PR when tests pass. :white_check_mark:
